fields.panel1_dialog: KPMG's 100+ agents ask considerably deeper audit questions.
fields.panel2_dialog: They match regulatory requirements to company documents, right?
fields.panel4_dialog: That part is still billable, right?

narrative_summary: KPMG's agents outperform auditors at questioning, while humans retain the task of matching rules to documents.
rationale: Candidate 1 is the only version that turns the story’s human-residual-task detail into a sharp, industry-specific punchline: even if AI handles the audit thinking, the work remains billable. The other candidates mostly restate the premise or end on an unearned “right?”
story_title: AI agents ask better questions than KPMG accountants in audit trial
